start_welcome_back:
💪 Welcome back! Your profile is set up.

Use the menu below 👇 or /help for all commands.
help: Commands /start — start or resume setup /workout — start or continue today's workout /app — full-screen workout logger (Mini App) /plan — your workout plan /food — log meals, daily calories and protein /progress — weight, PRs and charts /weight — log body weight (e.g. /weight 75.4) /measure — log a body measurement /achievements — streaks and achievements /reminders — workout and weigh-in reminders /exercises — exercise library /profile — your profile and daily calorie/protein targets /premium — Premium features /language — change language /settings — edit profile, disclaimer, delete data /about — about this bot and credits /paysupport — help with payments /deleteme — permanently delete all your data /cancel — stop the current step
about: Muscle Gain Bot Workout plans, logging, progress tracking and nutrition targets for bulking, lean bulking and recomposition. Nutrition targets use the Mifflin-St Jeor equation with a moderate surplus. Credits {attribution}
need_profile: You don't have a profile yet. Send /start to set one up (about 1 minute).
cancelled: Cancelled. Send /start to continue setup any time.
rate_limited: ⏳ Too fast — please wait a few seconds.
error: 😕 Something went wrong. Please try again. If it keeps happening, send /start.
stale_button: This button is no longer active.
disclaimer: ⚠️ Health disclaimer This bot gives general fitness and nutrition guidance. It is not medical advice and does not replace a doctor, physiotherapist or registered dietitian. Consult a qualified professional before starting a new training or nutrition plan, especially if you have a medical condition, injury, eating disorder history, or are under 18, pregnant or taking medication. Stop exercising and seek help if you feel pain, dizziness or chest discomfort.
onboarding_intro: Great! 10 quick questions to set up your plan. Most are one tap.
q_goal: What's your goal? • Bulk — maximum muscle gain, some fat gain • Lean bulk — slower gain, minimal fat • Recomposition — build muscle and lose fat at maintenance calories
q_age: How old are you? Type a number, e.g. 27
q_sex: Sex Used only for the calorie formula.
q_height_cm: Your height? Type it in cm, e.g. 178 (also accepts 1.78m or 5'10)
q_weight_kg: Your body weight? Type it in kg, e.g. 72.5 (also accepts 160 lb)
q_training_days: How many days per week can you train?
q_injuries: Any injuries or limitations? Tap all that apply, then Done. We'll avoid exercises that stress them.
err_not_a_number: Please send just a number, e.g. 75.
err_age: Please enter an age between 16 and 80.
err_height: Please enter a height between 130 and 220 cm (e.g. 178).
err_weight: Please enter a weight between 35 and 250 kg (e.g. 72.5).
err_generic: That answer isn't valid. Please use the buttons.
err_use_buttons: Please tap one of the buttons above.
profile: 👤 Your profile Goal: {goal} Age: {age} · Sex: {sex} Height: {height} cm · Weight: {weight} kg Experience: {experience} Training: {days} days/week · {equipment} Injuries: {injuries} Diet: {diet}
targets: 🍽 Daily targets Calories: {calories} kcal ({surplus_text}) Protein: {protein} g ({protein_basis}) Maintenance (TDEE) ≈ {tdee} kcal · BMR ≈ {bmr} kcal {gain_text}
protein_per_reference_kg: {g_per_kg} g/kg of a healthy reference weight, {basis} kg
gain_range: Aim to gain about {low}–{high} kg per week. If you gain faster, you're adding mostly fat.
gain_recomp: Aim to keep your body weight roughly stable while your strength goes up.
targets_footer: Estimates only — we'll fine-tune them from your weekly weigh-ins.
note_high_bmi_bulk: 💡 With your current body weight, lean bulk or recomposition usually gives better results than a full bulk. You can change your goal in /settings.
note_under_18: 💡 You're under 18: please involve a parent and a doctor before changing your diet, and focus on good technique over heavy weights.
edit_pick_field: Which field do you want to change?
delete_confirm: ⚠️ This permanently deletes all your data: profile, and any workouts, logs and progress. This can't be undone. Are you sure?
delete_done: ✅ All your data has been deleted. Send /start if you ever want to come back.
delete_nothing: We don't have any data stored for you.
library_pick_group_filtered: 📚 Exercise library Showing exercises that fit your equipment and level. Pick a muscle group:
library_empty: No exercises in this group fit your equipment and level.
no_exercises_loaded: The exercise list isn't loaded yet. Ask the admin to run import_exercises.py.
no_substitute: No substitute fits your equipment, level and injuries.
plan_footer: Rest 2–3 min between sets of big lifts, 60–90 s for smaller ones. Tap a day to go through its exercises.
plan_empty: Couldn't build a plan: the exercise list isn't loaded yet.
plan_rebuilt: 🗓 Your plan was rebuilt for the new settings: /plan
plan_changed: Your plan has changed. Open /plan again.
workout_overview_footer: Tap Start to log your sets. Wrong day? Pick another below.
workout_first_time: 📜 First time: pick a weight you could lift for about 2 more reps than the target ({low}–{high}), with good form.
workout_type_hint: Tip: you can also type a set, e.g. 62.5x8, or just 8 for reps.
workout_list: 📋 Exercises: tap one to jump to it.
hint_add_weight: 💡 You hit {reps} on every set: add weight → {weight} × {low}–{high}.
hint_add_reps: 💡 Same weight ({weight}), aim for {reps} on your weakest set.
hint_repeat: 💡 Stay at {weight} and get at least {low} on every set.
hint_reduce: 💡 Missed the target two workouts in a row: drop to {weight} and build back up.
hint_add_load: 💡 You hit {high} reps on every set: add a backpack/weight vest or try a harder variation.
swap_after_sets: You've already logged sets for this exercise. Swap it before the first set.
next_reduce: • {name}: drop to {weight} and build back up
next_add_load: • {name}: add load or try a harder variation
workout_next_day: Next workout: Day {n} · {name}. Rest well and hit your protein 💪
workout_discarded: Workout closed. Nothing was logged, so nothing was saved.
no_active_workout: No workout in progress. Send /workout to start one.
workout_ended: This workout has ended. Send /workout to start a new one.
err_set_weight: Weight must be between 0 and 500 kg.
err_set_reps: Reps must be between 1 and 100 (seconds: up to 600).
progress_trend_wait: 📊 Weekly trend appears after two weeks of weigh-ins.
trend_slow: Slower than your goal ({low}–{high} kg/week). If it stays like this for 2–3 weeks, add about 150 kcal a day.
trend_fast: Faster than your goal ({low}–{high} kg/week), so likely extra fat. If it stays like this for 2–3 weeks, eat about 150 kcal a day less.
trend_recomp_off: Your weight is changing more than expected for recomposition. Check you're near your calorie target.
progress_workouts: 🏋️ Workouts: {week} in the last 7 days · {month} in the last 30
weight_prompt: ⚖️ Log body weight Adjust and tap Log, or just type it (e.g. 75.4). Best: in the morning, after the toilet, before eating.
targets_updated: 🍽 Your daily targets were updated: {calories} kcal, {protein} g protein.
measure_pick: 📏 Which measurement? Measure relaxed, same time of day, tape snug but not tight.
measure_prompt: 📏 {kind}: adjust and tap Log, or type the value in cm.
err_measurement: Please enter a value between 15 and 200 cm.
strength_none: No weighted sets logged yet. Log a workout first: /workout
charts_unavailable: Charts are unavailable on this computer: the chart library couldn't be loaded.
chart_no_data: Not enough data for this chart yet. Keep logging!
prs_none: No PRs yet. Log a few workouts and they'll appear here.
reminders_off: ⏰ Reminders are off. To turn them on, tap the button that shows your current time (this sets your time zone): Or type a time zone name like Europe/Berlin.
reminders_tz_pick: 🌍 Tap the button that shows your current time: Or type a time zone name like Europe/Berlin (adjusts for daylight saving).
reminders_view: ⏰ Reminders 💪 Workouts: {workout} ⚖️ Weigh-in: {weighin} 🔔 Missed-workout nudge: {nudge} 🍽 Nutrition summary: {summary} 🌍 Time zone: {tz} (your time now {now})
reminders_nudge_on: on, at {time} if you haven't trained
reminders_tz_fixed_note: Fixed offset: re-pick it after daylight saving changes.
rem_tz_invalid: I don't know that time zone. Tap a button or try a name like Europe/London.
rem_all_off_done: 🔕 All reminders are off. Turn them on again any time with /reminders.
remind_workout: 💪 Workout day! Today: Day {n} · {name}. Ready when you are.
remind_nudge: 🤔 No workout today yet. Life happens! Want to move it?
remind_nudge_streak: You've missed {n} planned workouts in a row. A lighter schedule you can stick to beats a perfect one you can't.
resched_skipped: 👍 No problem. Rest up and get the next one.
fewer_days_done: ✅ Switched to {n} days a week. Your plan and reminders were updated: /plan
reminders_hint: ⏰ Want reminders for workouts and weigh-ins? /reminders
food_over: Over by {kcal} kcal · protein left: {protein} g
food_nothing_yet: Nothing logged yet today. Tap a food below.
food_week_avg: 📊 Last {days} logged days: avg {kcal} kcal · {protein} g protein
food_hint_over: 💡 Above target today. That's fine now and then; what counts is your weekly average.
food_hint_short: 💡 {kcal} kcal short. A shake, a bowl of oats or a PB sandwich closes the gap.
food_manual_tip: Tip: type /food 650 40 to log any meal (kcal, protein).
food_cat_empty: Nothing here fits your diet preference.
food_logged: ✅ {name}{serving}{servings}: {kcal} kcal, {protein} g protein Different amount? Tap ×½ to ×2.
food_edit_header: 🗑 Tap an entry to delete it:
food_manual_prompt: ✍️ Manual entry Type calories and protein, optionally with a name: 650 40 or chicken wrap 650 40
err_manual_format: Please type calories then protein, e.g. 650 40 or chicken wrap 650 40.
err_meal_kcal: Calories for one entry must be between 1 and 3000.
err_meal_protein_range: Protein for one entry must be between 0 and 300 g.
err_meal_protein: That's more protein than the calories allow (1 g protein = 4 kcal). Check the numbers.
streak_line: 🔥 Weekly streak: {weeks} week(s) · this week {done}/{goal} workouts
ach_streak_2_desc: hit your weekly workout goal 2 weeks in a row
ach_streak_4_desc: hit your weekly workout goal 4 weeks in a row
ach_streak_8_desc: hit your weekly workout goal 8 weeks in a row
ach_streak_12_desc: hit your weekly workout goal 12 weeks in a row
ach_protein_3_desc: hit your protein target 3 days in a row
ach_protein_7_desc: hit your protein target 7 days in a row
ach_protein_30_desc: hit your protein target 30 days in a row
deload_offer: 🧘 Time for a deload week? No progress lately on: {names}. Stalls often mean fatigue has built up. One lighter week (fewer sets, about 10% less weight) usually lets you come back stronger.
deload_started: ✅ Deload week until {until}: fewer sets and about 10% lighter. Your normal plan comes back automatically after that.
deload_banner: 🧘 Deload week until {until}: lighter and fewer sets
hint_deload: 🧘 Deload: use {weight}, about {low} easy reps. No grinding.
kcal_offer_up: 📈 Weight gain has been slower than your goal for 2 weeks ({trend} kg/week). Add {kcal} kcal a day? New target: {new} kcal.
kcal_offer_down: 📉 Weight has been going up faster than your goal for 2 weeks ({trend} kg/week), so likely extra fat. Eat {kcal} kcal a day less? New target: {new} kcal.
kcal_applied: ✅ Your daily target is now {calories} kcal. Give it 2 weeks before judging.
adjust_dismissed: 👍 Okay, no changes. I'll check again in a couple of weeks.
admin_stats: 🛠 Bot stats Users: {users} ({profiles} finished onboarding) New in the last 7 days: {new_7d} Active in the last 7 days: {active_7d} Workouts finished in the last 7 days: {workouts_7d} Premium users: {premium} · Stars in the last 30 days: {stars_30d} ⭐ Send a message to everyone: /broadcast your text (you get a preview first). Refund a payment: /refund payment-id
broadcast_confirm: ☝️ This is the preview. Send it to all users?
broadcast_done: ✅ Broadcast finished: {sent} sent, {blocked} blocked the bot, {failed} failed.

premium_trial_started: 🎁 Premium is free for {days} days, until {until}. Try the charts in /progress!
premium_invoice_desc: Progress charts and smart suggestions for {days} days.
premium_checkout_error: The price changed. Please open /premium again.
premium_thanks: 🎉 Thank you! Premium is active until {until}. Payment ID: {charge} (keep it for /paysupport).

app_not_configured: 📱 The Mini App isn't set up yet (the admin needs to set WEBAPP_URL). You can log workouts with /workout.
app_open: 📱 Day {n} · {name} Tap the button below to open the logger. When you're done, tap Finish and save in the app.
app_bad_data: 😕 I couldn't read the data from the app. Please try again with /app.
app_skipped: ⚠️ {n} set(s) had invalid values and were skipped.
menu_ready: 👇 Everything is in the menu below. /help lists all commands.
app_promo: 📱 Gym24 app Your plan, workouts and progress in a full-screen app. You can also open it with the Gym24 button next to the message box.
app_setup_done: ✅ Your Gym24 profile is set up! Your workout plan and daily targets are ready. Use the menu below 👇
